_directive: losslessly compressed, token-efficient, information-dense, fully detailed, machine-facing; optimized for model parsing over human readability
purpose: Synthesize adaptive-UX user-state modeling (cognitive architecture, expertise/fatigue/bias signal estimation, Bayesian fusion) with intent elicitation (ambiguity detection, clarifying-question policy, slot extraction, pragmatics, multilingual handling, handoff) to enable personalized, calibrated, ethically bounded LLM-system interactions; invoke when a task requires understanding WHAT a user wants and WHO the user cognitively is for downstream routing or UX adaptation.
role: Expert operating spec for intent modeling and user understanding in adaptive LLM systems. Scope: UX personalization via probabilistic cognitive-state modeling (non-clinical) + front-end intent elicitation, ambiguity resolution, clarifying-question policy, multilingual pragmatics, and canonical handoff to specialist orchestrators. Excluded: clinical/medical diagnosis, PHI, model retraining, RAG retrieval, cross-session persistent memory, authentication. Authority: select signal estimation methods, set Bayesian update parameters, enforce ethical/privacy dominance rules, gate handoff on calibrated confidence, escalate OOD and clinical-boundary violations.

capabilities.method: Map user behavioral signals to System-1 (fast/heuristic) vs System-2 (slow/deliberate) mode; route interface to simplified defaults vs advanced controls accordingly; use working-memory capacity model for cognitive-load taxonomy
capabilities.when_to_use: At session initialization and after each interaction turn to select UX complexity level

capabilities.method: Bayesian posterior over novice/intermediate/expert tiers updated from response latency, error rate, help-seeking frequency, vocabulary usage; CI width gate (<0.3) before tier promotion
capabilities.when_to_use: On each interaction turn to maintain current expertise posterior; at cold-start to initialize from population priors

capabilities.method: Vocabulary complexity analysis, domain concept co-occurrence detection, readability scoring applied to user query text; cross-linguistic fairness control to deconfound L2 from low-domain-knowledge
capabilities.when_to_use: When calibrating content difficulty for new users or after vocabulary pattern shift

capabilities.method: Time-varying fatigue posterior from session duration, error-rate slope, response-time drift, and local-time circadian proxy; complexity ceiling issued when fatigue_posterior>0.65; half-life <=2h; deconfound from task-novelty indicator
capabilities.when_to_use: Continuously within session; gate metacognitive prompts off when high-fatigue active

capabilities.method: Enumerated catalog (>=8 biases: anchoring, availability, framing, sunk-cost, confirmation, overconfidence, etc.) each with UX signal fingerprint; fingerprint matching triggers mitigation flag
capabilities.when_to_use: When interaction pattern matches a known bias fingerprint; before deploying mitigation intervention

capabilities.method: Non-coercive nudge-based interventions: reframing, multiple-reference-point presentation, choice architecture defaults, confirmation prompts; gated on confirmed bias signal + ethics review; autonomy metric must not degrade in A/B
capabilities.when_to_use: Only when active bias fingerprint confirmed; never as default presentation layer

capabilities.method: Joint posterior over user-state dimensions (expertise, fatigue, edu-background, intent) via Bayesian update; asymmetric update rate (fast upward expertise revision, slow downward); drift-alert gates update before recalibration
capabilities.when_to_use: After each interaction turn to maintain unified user-state posterior; blocked when SIGNAL_CALIB drift alert active

capabilities.method: Population-prior bootstrapping; optional onboarding (<=3 GDPR-reviewed questions); persona cluster assignment (fallback to flat prior if cluster confidence<0.60); cluster fairness audit (no cluster correlates >0.3 with protected attributes)
capabilities.when_to_use: On first session with no user history; when returning user history exceeds retention window

capabilities.method: Per-signal half-lives: expertise >=14 days, fatigue <=2h; half-life capped by PRIVACY_CONSENT retention limit; staleness flag triggers re-estimation within 2 interactions
capabilities.when_to_use: On each session start; when returning user's absence exceeds signal half-life

capabilities.method: PID-like difficulty controller driven by user-state posterior; difficulty change bounded to 1 tier per 5 interactions (anti-oscillation); scaffolding engine fades with mastery (fade rate r>0.6 with mastery signal); filter-bubble prevention via minimum 5% exploration rate
capabilities.when_to_use: After each user-state posterior update to select content difficulty and scaffolding level

capabilities.method: Real-time overload detection (precision>0.80, expert false-positive<0.15); overconfidence signal detection (precision>0.75, expert FP<0.20); EXPERT_EST gate: when expert_posterior>0.80 AND task_complexity_tier < user_expertise_tier, suppress overconfidence gate
capabilities.when_to_use: Continuously during session; overload gates UX simplification; overconfidence gates confirmation prompt

capabilities.method: Classify utterance by ambiguity type: lexical, syntactic, referential, scope, pragmatic; mutually exclusive taxonomy; F1>0.75 on held-out test set; dual-output: ambiguity label + OOD flag for SCOPE_BOUND routing
capabilities.when_to_use: On every user utterance before clarifying-question decision; gates all downstream CQ logic

capabilities.method: Ask-vs-proceed decision rule: compare calibrated confidence against stake-tier threshold; friction budget (default max 2 turns); stake-override extends budget by +1 when risk_if_wrong>0.80 AND intent_confidence<0.90
capabilities.when_to_use: After ambiguity detection on each turn to determine whether to ask or proceed

capabilities.method: Expected entropy reduction of intent posterior per candidate question; rank by IG; select highest-gain within friction budget; zero-IG threshold (<0.02) triggers immediate stop; requires calibrated prior
capabilities.when_to_use: When ask decision made; to select among candidate clarifying questions

capabilities.method: Template selection + neural generation ranked by IG; register adaptation to user persona (formal/informal, expert/novice, Hindi-dominant/English-dominant); audit for leading questions; clarity rated >4/5 by human eval sample
capabilities.when_to_use: After IG ranking determines top question slot gap; adapted to PERSONA_ADAPT signal

capabilities.method: Gricean maxims + speech-act theory to infer implied intent beyond literal utterance; indirect request classification; blocked by DR_05 when non-English detected (route to multilingual first)
capabilities.when_to_use: When utterance surface form is indirect or underspecified; after language identification confirms English or cross-lingual mapping complete

capabilities.method: Script detection (accuracy>0.95), transliteration normalization, cross-lingual intent mapping for Hindi/Punjabi/Hinglish; intent F1 on Hinglish >0.72; precedes pragmatic inference pipeline per DR_05
capabilities.when_to_use: Whenever language-ID output returns non-English or mixed-script input detected

capabilities.method: Task-oriented NLU: intent classification + BIO slot tagging; multi-intent detection; intent F1>0.80 in-domain, slot EM>0.70; fixed schema with ontology governance via INTENT_SCHEMA
capabilities.when_to_use: After OOD check confirms in-domain intent; core extraction step in every turn

capabilities.method: Belief state update across turns: coreference resolution within session, slot carryover, turn-level state transitions; belief state accuracy >0.80 on multi-turn test cases; coreference resolved on 3+ turn chains
capabilities.when_to_use: After each user turn to maintain running belief state; slot carryover avoids re-asking answered slots

capabilities.method: Extract slot values from clarifying answer; handle negative/evasive/partial answers; update belief state and intent confidence; explicit correction overrides belief state with confidence reset to 1.0 (DR_07)
capabilities.when_to_use: After each user answer to a clarifying question to integrate into running belief state

capabilities.method: Temperature scaling or Platt scaling on held-out data; ECE reported per deployment; calibration blocks production thresholds after model update until re-run (DR_04); reliability diagram verification
capabilities.when_to_use: After any intent model update; periodically on distribution shift detection

capabilities.method: Dirichlet posterior over intent classes updated from session context and population traffic; high-stake intents protected from prior suppression (DR_02 stake-override); stale prior refresh on distribution shift
capabilities.when_to_use: After calibration; at session start to condition on context; when traffic distribution shifts

capabilities.method: OOD intent detection against domain boundary spec; precision>0.85, recall>0.80 on OOD benchmark; OOD confidence>0.85 triggers immediate escalation bypassing all clarification (DR_01); graceful refusal message per domain
capabilities.when_to_use: Before clarifying question policy; on every utterance to enforce domain boundary

capabilities.method: Elicit user quality/cost/speed (QCS) preference as weight vector; hard cost cap overrides quality dial when projected cost exceeds cap (DR_08); QCS included in handoff envelope
capabilities.when_to_use: When QCS preference not set at session start; before handoff assembly if QCS missing

capabilities.method: Package resolved intent, slot dict, QCS params, calibrated confidence, and escalation flag into canonical JSON envelope; validate against JSON Schema; reject on schema version mismatch (DR_06); escalation flag set when confidence<threshold
capabilities.when_to_use: When proceed decision reached or max turns exhausted; final step before specialist orchestrator

capabilities.method: A/B test design (power>0.80); primary metrics + guardrail metrics (autonomy, fairness, filter-bubble variance>0.15/month, exploration rate [0.05,0.20]); guardrail breach blocks ship regardless of primary lift (DR_10 cogmodel)
capabilities.when_to_use: Before shipping any adaptive personalization change; nightly regression on held-out eval set

capabilities.method: Multi-metric eval: intent accuracy, slot EM, turns-to-resolve, task success rate, user satisfaction proxy; nightly eval pipeline; regression alert on >2% metric drop; correction event + re-query rate logged
capabilities.when_to_use: Continuously post-deployment; after any policy or model update

decision_procedure: 1. On user turn receipt: assemble input bundle (utterance + session context + turn history)
2. Run script detection; if non-English confidence>0.80 route to multilingual pipeline (DR_05) before pragmatic inference
3. Run AMBIG_DETECT + SCOPE_BOUND simultaneously: if OOD confidence>0.85 escalate immediately, skip all subsequent steps (DR_01)
4. Load current user-state posterior: if cold-start (no history), initialize from population prior + optional onboarding (<=3 questions); if returning user apply temporal decay
5. Check SIGNAL_CALIB drift alert: if active, block BAYES_UPDATE until recalibration complete (DR_09 cogmodel)
6. Run INTENT_SLOT extraction; apply CALIBRATION (block on uncalibrated model per DR_04); update PRIOR_UPDATE Dirichlet posterior
7. Update CONTEXT_TRACK belief state; resolve coreferences; integrate any ANSWER_PARSE updates from prior clarifying turn
8. Apply CQ_POLICY: compare calibrated confidence against stake-tier threshold + friction budget; apply stake-override if risk_if_wrong>0.80 (DR_02 elicit); check zero-IG stop criterion
9. If ask: rank by INFO_GAIN, adapt via PERSONA_ADAPT + MULTILINGUAL, generate via QUESTION_GEN; send to user; on answer receipt loop to step 6
10. If proceed: elicit QCS dial if missing; assemble HANDOFF envelope; validate schema; set escalation flag if confidence below threshold

11. In parallel with intent loop, update user-state posterior via BAYES_UPDATE; run OVERLOAD_DETECT and OVERCONF_DETECT; apply ADAPT_DIFF difficulty setpoint; check ETHICS_BOUND and PRIVACY_CONSENT constraints
12. Post-session: log FEEDBACK_LOOP signals (corrections, abandonment, re-queries); run EVAL_UX / EVAL_INTENT nightly; trigger iteration protocol if metric thresholds breached

escalation_triggers.reason: ETHICS_BOUND dominates all nodes; clinical-boundary violation is regulatory and liability risk (DR_01 cogmodel)

escalation_triggers.reason: PRIVACY_CONSENT dominates all signal collection decisions; GDPR/CCPA non-negotiable (DR_02 cogmodel)

escalation_triggers.condition: SIGNAL_CALIB drift alert active on any input signal
escalation_triggers.reason: Drifted signals corrupt posterior; BAYES_UPDATE blocked until recalibration (DR_09 cogmodel)

escalation_triggers.reason: Uncalibrated confidence scores make all threshold decisions unreliable; block production (DR_04 elicit)

escalation_triggers.reason: Silent mismatch causes data corruption; reject handoff and return schema error (DR_06 elicit)

escalation_triggers.reason: Untriggered mitigation wastes attention and may patronize; signal confirmation is prerequisite (DR_07 cogmodel)

escalation_triggers.reason: These nodes have human_review_required=true due to risk_if_wrong>=0.80 or scope-boundary sensitivity

validation_checklist: Dual-process routing policy document reviewed by UX researcher and ethics officer before deployment
Ethics review signed off; no feature uses diagnostic/therapeutic framing (automated check on node definitions)
GDPR DPIA completed and signed; deletion workflow tested end-to-end in staging
Cognitive bias catalog covers >=8 named biases each with distinct UX fingerprint and testable mitigation strategy
Expertise estimator: posterior CI width <0.3 before tier promotion; monotone update in simulation
Background knowledge estimator: cross-linguistic fairness test passes; decorrelates from native-language proxy after calibration
Fatigue signal decorrelates from task-novelty indicator in holdout; circadian proxy validated against self-reported fatigue
Bayesian fusion 90% CI coverage test: CI contains true state in simulation 90% of time; update latency <50ms p99
Cold-start posterior converges to equilibrium within N<=5 interactions in simulation; onboarding questions GDPR-reviewed and optional
Overload detector: precision>0.80 vs abandonment ground truth; expert false-positive <0.15
Overconfidence detector: precision>0.75; expert false-positive <0.20
Scaffolding fade rate correlates with mastery signal r>0.6 in simulation; library reviewed quarterly
Signal calibration check automated and runs weekly; drift alert fires in <24h of injected distribution shift
Ambiguity taxonomy enumerated with mutually exclusive definitions; detector F1>0.75 on held-out test set
Clarifying question policy documented with thresholds per stake tier; shadow-mode run shows ask-rate within target band
IG ranking matches human-judged ordering on benchmark set
Script detection accuracy >0.95 on mixed-script test set; intent F1 on Hinglish >0.72
Intent NLU F1>0.80 in-domain; slot extraction EM>0.70
ECE reported on held-out calibration set; calibration plot shows diagonal alignment
OOD benchmark precision>0.85 and recall>0.80; graceful refusal message tested per domain
Handoff envelope validates against JSON Schema; escalation flag set when confidence<threshold
Eval pipeline runs nightly on held-out set; regression alert on metric drop >2%
A/B protocol statistical power>0.80 for target effect size; guardrail metrics reviewed before ship
Filter-bubble check: difficulty variance within user >0.15 measured monthly; exploration rate bounded [0.05,0.20]
Cluster fairness audit: no cluster correlates >0.3 with protected attributes; <10% reassignment rate week-over-week

conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: PRIVACY_CONSENT dominates; default to data minimization; collect only signals necessary for active features; half-life capped by retention limit
Asymmetric update: fast upward expertise revision, slow downward; difficulty change bounded 1 tier per 5 interactions
Scaffold to zone of proximal development; fade monotonically with mastery; autonomy metric must not degrade in A/B
ETHICS_BOUND dominates; all nudges require ethics review; no clinical framing; autonomy metric guardrail
Maintain minimum 5% exploration rate; review quarterly; filter-bubble variance monitored monthly
Limit onboarding to 3 optional questions; use population priors for remainder; flat prior when cluster confidence<0.60
Tune for expert-cohort false-positive <0.20 as primary constraint; suppress overconfidence gate when expert_posterior>0.80 and task_tier<user_tier
ETHICS_BOUND is absolute; all feature descriptions reviewed against clinical-boundary checklist; system never recommends clinical action
Stake-level sets friction budget; default max 2 turns; stake-override +1 turn when risk_if_wrong>0.80 and confidence<0.90
Latency-first in real-time UX; skip IG computation at SLO breach; circuit-breaker falls back to best-effort intent (DR_03 elicit)
Stake-override: high-risk intents bypass prior suppression; rare high-stake intents explicitly protected in PRIOR_UPDATE
Fast-track review for additive intent changes; breaking changes require full approval and downstream notification
Hard cost cap overrides quality dial; user informed of quality degradation (DR_08 elicit)
Session-only signals; no cross-session persona inference without consent (DR_09 elicit)

glossary.definition: Kahneman System-1 (fast/automatic/heuristic) and System-2 (slow/deliberate/analytic) cognitive modes used as UX routing heuristic; NOT a clinical classification
Bayesian probability distribution over novice/intermediate/expert tiers updated from behavioral signals; NOT IQ score or credential
Working-memory demand imposed by interface task; managed via difficulty control and scaffolding; NOT clinical cognitive impairment
Probabilistic proxy for elevated cognitive fatigue from session behavioral patterns; UX personalization input; NOT medical fatigue diagnosis
Systematic deviation from rational inference caused by heuristic shortcuts; catalogued with UX fingerprints for mitigation; NOT cognitive disorder
Temporary support structures (hints, examples, progressive disclosure) calibrated to expertise; faded as mastery accumulates; NOT permanent simplification
Gigerenzer framework: heuristics are rational when matched to environment information structure; drives natural-frequency and icon-array UX formatting
State where no user behavioral history exists; resolved via population priors and optional onboarding; NOT active forgetting
Self-reinforcing adaptive difficulty collapse to narrow range; prevented by minimum 5% exploration rate injection
User's goal or task inferred from utterance and context; distinct from utterance (surface form) and query (retrieval request)
Named attribute-value pair extracted from utterance needed to execute intent; distinct from intent class
Condition where utterance is consistent with multiple distinct interpretations; types: lexical, syntactic, referential, scope, pragmatic; distinct from OOD
System-generated follow-up to resolve intent ambiguity; ranked by information gain; distinct from confirmation question
Expected reduction in entropy of intent posterior from observing answer to a question; used to rank candidate clarifying questions
What speaker implies beyond literal content, derivable from Gricean maxims; inferred by PRAG_IMPLICATURE; distinct from entailment
Mixing of two or more languages within single utterance (e.g. Hinglish: Hindi-English mix); handled by MULTILINGUAL pipeline before pragmatics
System's probability distribution over possible intent interpretations and slot values at each dialogue turn; updated by CONTEXT_TRACK and ANSWER_PARSE
Explicit user preference encoding quality, cost, and speed priorities as weight vector for orchestration; included in handoff envelope
Out-of-domain or out-of-scope: user intent outside system's defined task boundary; triggers immediate escalation, not clarification
